interval_interpretation: Path-specific working Bonferroni-eight t14 interval; known calibration failures prevent nominal confidence claim
null_score_identity: S(H)=H.T@(Y-mu_null); nuisance and cell null fit excludes H and does not change with candidate H
sharpness_argument: Concave profile likelihood, finite unique identified fitted slope; its sign equals null profile-score sign. Largest beneficial unit-cost score reductions minimize correction count within declared class. Verified finite fits on both boundary sides.
